note: Contestants. provider 'anthropic' uses the SDK (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or an `ant auth login` profile); 'openai' is any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions (OpenRouter, Strata on ml1). price is $ per million tokens [input, output], used only where the provider does not report cost. OpenRouter slugs change: `run.ts --list-openrouter` prints the current cheap vision models. Add `--model=openrouter:<slug>` to try one without editing this file.

models.note: Not a contestant: a ceiling, to tell a model limit from a setup limit.

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_XXS through Strata on ml1 (32K context, pictures via the CPU reader at ~10 s each). 'auto' takes the first id /v1/models lists. Key: STRATA_TOKEN in the repo-root .env (from `~/.local/bin/strata launch --show-key --preset ml1` on ml1).
